gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-lao-looped: Glowing and vibrant, Neon draws every letter in one unbroken line width, like tubing bent into shape. And Noto Sans Lao Looped runs a long paragraph in solid, even-textured blocks, its bowls left open on one side.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Neon traces tall, stamped-metal lowercase in a single uninterrupted line width, with no stress in any curve at all. Noto Sans Lepcha, a plain sans, brings wide-mouthed curves beneath it.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Neon's constant-thickness strokes look like glowing tubing bent into letters. Below it, Noto Sans Limbu, a sans-serif with tall-bodied small letters and gaping curves, gives the page a more approachable, contemporary voice.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Professional in manner, Noto Sans Lisu sits under Neon's single unbroken line weight, which runs from terminals to junctions without a wobble. Its wide s curves keep a long passage moving.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Neon draws its tall lowercase with no calligraphic swelling anywhere, every outline glowing at the same width, while Noto Sans Lydian keeps capitals barely above lowercase. Give Neon the larger size.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Noto Sans Mahajani stands its lowercase tall against the capitals, with a funnel-wide throat in the e. And Neon's laser-etched, constant-width trace makes a glowing contrast whenever you read a long passage beneath it.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Noto Sans Malayalam, a plain sans, lets the middle zone dominate each line, with generous openings in its s. But Neon is the one that glows, giving even its t a crossbar and stem of one width.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Marker-traced neon glow, then a loose, curvy sans-serif underneath. Neon does best with its tall, vibrant lowercase, but Noto Sans Mandaic does best with lowercase rising close to capitals and curves that feel unclamped.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Glowing curves that never thin at the shoulders. Neon makes a vivid headline, and Noto Sans Marchen, a plain sans, follows with small letters standing almost capital-sized and curves ending in clear daylight.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numer: Noto Sans Mayan Numerals reads tall-bodied and contemporary, with a visibly gaping c at any size. And Neon, its strokes looking traced with a marker, earns its keep when big and short.
